provenance: ADR-032 §d, the invariant-suite half of S9's acceptance, stated the way tables-offsets-invariant states ADR-029's: extract_items(path, blocks=True) and extract_items(path, blocks=False) on the same file, DETERMINISM_FIELDS compared field by field, no blocks/tables key without the flag, both lists with it. aapl-2025 is a PRIMARY .htm with no <DOCUMENT> wrapper — the shape on which the first build of ADR-032 returned NO blocks at all when asked (the split_documents list shadowed the `blocks` parameter, and an unwrapped filing's list is empty; ADR-032 §g). This case is red on that defect; blocks-wrapped-invariant is red on its other half. blocks_sane also asserts the coverage rule: every non-space character of normalized_text lies inside some block, so the Markdown view can lose no text. Bands around HEAD's 698 blocks and 54 tables.
